This Privacy Policy explains how APeX (“APeX,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use the APeX mobile application (the “App”). It applies to athletes and coaches/managers who use the App. By creating an account, you agree to the practices described here.

⚠ If anything below doesn’t match how the App actually behaves, that’s a bug in this document, not in your rights — please contact us (Section 11) and we will correct it.
01

Who This Applies To

APeX has two kinds of users:

  • Athletes, who record short movement/exercise videos for automated performance and readiness analysis, either independently or as part of a team.
  • Coaches/Managers, who create a team, invite athletes to join it via an invite code, and view their team’s performance and readiness data.

An athlete may also use APeX independently, with no coach or team attached — in that case, no one else can see their data (see Section 4).

02

Information We Collect

2.1Account Information

When you create an account, we collect your email address, a password (stored securely, hashed — we never see or store it in plain text), your full name, and your role (athlete or coach/manager). If you sign up as a coach, we also collect the team name you create; if you sign up as an athlete joining a team, we collect the invite code you enter to link your account to that team.

2.2Athlete Profile Information

Athletes may provide height, weight, playing position, and date of birth. This is optional and used only to personalize your readiness tracking (e.g., unit conversion, age display) — you can leave any of it blank.

2.3Movement Videos

The core feature of APeX is recording a short (about 20 seconds or less) video of yourself performing a movement (e.g., a few tennis swings), which is uploaded so our system can analyze your movement. A few important specifics:

  • Video only, no audio. Recordings made in-app are captured with audio explicitly disabled — we do not collect or store sound from your recordings.
  • Videos are uploaded to secure, private cloud storage and are not publicly accessible — only you, and your coach/manager if you belong to a team (Section 4), can access them.
  • After processing, we generate a second, derived video with a visual movement/skeleton overlay so you can review your form — this is stored alongside the original.
  • You can delete any individual recorded session at any time from the app, which permanently removes both the original and processed video files from our storage, not just from your view of them.

2.4Movement & Fitness Analysis Data

From each video, our system computes and stores fitness-related metrics tied to your account, including: repetition counts, a readiness score, left/right balance, and range-of-motion measurements. This data is used to show you trends over time and, if you’re on a team, to give your coach/manager visibility into your training status (Section 4). This is the same category of data commonly referred to as “Health & Fitness” data, and we treat it with that sensitivity even though it does not include medical diagnoses or records from a healthcare provider.

2.5Injury Status

If you’re on a team, your coach/manager can mark you as injured or recovered within the app. This flag, and the date it was set, is visible to you and to your coach/manager. We do not collect any medical details beyond this simple status flag — APeX is a training/readiness tool, not a medical diagnostic device, and this flag does not constitute medical advice or a diagnosis.

2.6Team & Coach Visibility Data

If your account is linked to a team, your coach/manager can see: your name, profile information, recorded sessions and their videos, computed readiness and performance history, your assigned/required exercises, and your injury status. See Section 4 for exactly what’s shared and why.

2.7Push Notification Data

If you enable notifications, we store a device push token (provided by Apple/Google/Expo’s push infrastructure, not a message itself) so we can alert you — for example, when your video analysis is ready. You can disable this at any time in your device’s notification settings; declining notification permission doesn’t limit any other part of the app.

2.8What We Do NOT Collect

We do not run advertising or ad-tracking of any kind, we do not use third-party analytics SDKs, we do not sell your data to anyone, and we do not use your videos or fitness data to train any third-party AI product.

03

How We Use Your Information

We use the information above to:

  • Operate your account (authentication, login, password reset).
  • Process your recorded videos into movement analysis and readiness scores.
  • Show you your own performance history and trends.
  • Let your coach/manager (if any) monitor your team’s readiness and compliance, exactly as described in Section 4.
  • Send you optional push notifications you’ve enabled.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of the App (e.g., preventing abuse).

We do not use your data for any purpose beyond operating the features of the App itself.

04

How Information Is Shared

Within a team: if your account is linked to a team (via an invite code), your coach/manager can view the data listed in Section 2.6. This is a core, disclosed feature of the App, not a third-party data share — your coach is using the same App, under the same account system, to do their job of monitoring their athletes’ training. An individual (teamless) athlete’s data is never visible to anyone but that athlete.

With service providers who help us run the App, under confidentiality obligations, and only as needed to provide the App’s functionality:

  • Supabase — our database, authentication, and file storage provider. Your account data, videos, and performance data are hosted on Supabase’s infrastructure.
  • Expo — the push-notification relay service that delivers notifications to your device, if you’ve enabled them.
  • Our own video-processing servers — where uploaded videos are analyzed to produce movement/readiness data. This processing is performed by us, not by a third-party AI vendor, and videos are not shared outside this processing pipeline.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with advertisers, data brokers, or any other third party for their own marketing purposes.

We may also disclose information if required by law, to comply with a valid legal process, or to protect the rights, safety, or property of APeX, our users, or the public.

05

Data Storage & Security

Your data is stored on Supabase’s cloud infrastructure using industry-standard security practices, including encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and access controls that restrict each account to its own data (and, for team athletes, to their coach/manager — nothing more). Video storage is private by default; no recording is ever publicly accessible.

No method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we work to protect your information using practices appropriate to its sensitivity.

06

Data Retention & Deletion

We retain your account and performance data for as long as your account is active, so you (and your coach/manager, if applicable) can review your history over time.

You can permanently delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account, in the App. This is a full, irreversible deletion — not a deactivation — and removes:

  • Your profile and login credentials.
  • Every recorded video (original and processed) from our storage.
  • Your session history, readiness scores, and routine settings.
  • Any notifications referencing you.

If you’re a coach/manager, deleting your account removes only your own account — it does not delete your team or your athletes’ data, since that data belongs to them, not to you.

Deletion typically takes effect immediately; some backup copies may persist briefly afterward and are purged on our routine backup-rotation schedule.

07

Your Rights & Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing. You can exercise most of these directly in the App:

  • Access/correct your profile: edit it directly in Settings.
  • Delete your account and all associated data: Settings → Delete Account (see Section 6).
  • Camera/photo library permissions: grant or revoke these at any time in your device’s system settings; the App will ask again only when you try to use the related feature.
  • Notifications: enable/disable at any time in your device’s system settings.

For any request not covered directly in the App (e.g., a full data export, or a request under a specific privacy law), contact us using the details in Section 11 and we will respond within the time required by applicable law.

08

Children’s Privacy

APeX is not directed at, and is not intended for use by, children under 13, and account creation requires confirming you are 13 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has created an account, please contact us so we can delete it.

09

International Users

Our service providers may store and process data in countries other than the one you live in. Wherever your information is processed, we require appropriate safeguards to protect it consistent with this Policy.

10

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the effective date above and, where required, notify you in the App. Continued use of APeX after an update means you accept the revised Policy.
